title: McClung Museum

services.name: School Programs
services.desc: The McClung Museum offers a variety of on-site and off-site programs for preK-12 groups that meet the curriculum of Tennessee public schools. Students will learn to use visual analysis of objects in our collection to enhance their understanding of history, art, and science. On-site programs and admission to the McClung Museum are free. Programs take place in the galleries and are based on the content of the exhibits, which have direct connections to the current science, social studies, or visual arts curricula of Tennessee public schools for specific grade levels. Contact Leslie Chang Jantz, curator of education, for programming and scheduling questions at [email protected]. Off-site
